create_audio_vae_model: create an AudioVAE model with causal encoder-decoder for audio waveform compression
encode_audio_waveform: encode audio waveform tensor into latent representation using the causal encoder
decode_latent_to_audio: decode latent tensor back to audio waveform with optional sample rate conditioning
streaming_decode_audio: streaming decode audio chunks statefully without redundant overlap decoding
configure_sample_rate_conditioning: configure sample rate conditioning with scale-bias or add embedding for multi-rate audio
